title: Check CPU architecture (Intel or Apple Silicon)
summary: Use the `machine` command to quickly see if your Mac uses an Intel or Apple Silicon processor. This helps when downloading software that requires a specific version.

aliases.text: is my mac intel or apple silicon

steps.explain: Run the `machine` command in Terminal to print the CPU architecture.
steps.expect: The output will show the architecture, such as 'arm64' for Apple Silicon or 'x86_64' for Intel.

alternatives.explain: Run the arch command to display the current system architecture.
alternatives.expect: The output will be either 'i386' (for Intel) or 'arm64' (for Apple Silicon).
